newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: SOUTHERN LIFE SEES ONGOING DIVIDEND GROWTH.
newsitem.headline: SOUTHERN LIFE SEES ONGOING DIVIDEND GROWTH.

text.p: Southern Life Association of South Africa Ltd said on Wednesday it expected dividend growth to continue based on the group's financial strength and sound operating performance.
"Southern Life continues to be well capitalised and is strategically positioned to take advantage of developments in the financial services industry," chief executive Jan Calitz said.
"The financial strength of the company and its sound operating performance will ensure continued dividend growth," he said in a statement.
He said the life assurance group was looking at increasing growth by offering competitive products to meet customer needs in selected niche markets.

Calitz said although the group's excess of assets over actuarial liabilities had risen significantly over the last two years, poorer returns on investment products was expected to cap an increase in this financial year.

"This excess is affected by the market values of assets and during the six months under review was adversely impacted by the poor performance of investment markets and share prices on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange," Calitz said.
"Unless those markets show significant recovery, the excess in not expected to increase over the previous year," he said.
